This document makes no claim about secret-binding ownership, route status codes or binding visibility, so no prose change.

Fix round 1 for #3279: rewrote the Ownership paragraph's viewer sentence. Checked against secret-binding-administration.ts (SecretBindingNotFoundError thrown by requiredActiveBinding and by the integration service's requiredVisibleBinding/requiredBindingAtRevision; viewer passed to get/grant/ungrant inside bind/unbind; getIntegrationBindings filters by list(viewer)), secret-bindings.ts (viewer passed to consumer bind/unbind and the integration projection; secretBindingRouteFailure maps the not-found type to 404 with SECRET_BINDING_NOT_FOUND_MESSAGE, the GET route uses the same constant) and mcp-service.ts migrateStoredEnv (get/grant with no viewer, so instance-only). Executed: connected-accounts.e2e.test.ts compares status and response bytes for another person's binding versus a nonexistent id on get, replace, revoke, bind and unbind before and after the owner binds, and covers owner bind/unbind and an instance binding through the HTTP routes. Limits: validation that precedes the lookup (body shape, integration/env checks) returns 400 identically for both; audit log reasons still record not-found as invalid_request.
